profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer II at Chaos Industries
profile.summary:
I am a graduate with a BMS in Computer Science from California Polytechnic State University San Luis Obispo. I have experience coding in C, C++, JAVA and Python and am particularly interested in topics related to Computer Security and Networks.

I have worked successfully individually and within team environments on various projects covering all aspects of computer engineering. I have designed and developed computer games, written professional-quality software programs, and constructed complex digital circuits including a functioning CPU.

projects.title: Wi-Fi Controlled Surveillance Vehicle
projects.description:
For our Internet of Things class final project, our team wanted to create a basic surveillance system that could be accessible from any computer or phone with a Wi-Fi connection as well as mobile to be able to cover more ground than a stationary camera. The final system was a three-wheeled car chassis with a microcontroller, a Wi-Fi shield, and a camera module mounted on top. 

The class required the use of the Freescale FRDM-K64F microcontroller as the main control board. We then interfaced this board with the Wi-Fi shield that connected via Websocket to our back-end server. Next, we attached the UART camera module to the microcontroller. Finally, the chassis motors were connected to the PWM pins on the board.

Our team also developed the Web client that would connect to the server and allow the user to move the car in the cardinal directions via buttons as well as display the picture data from the camera.
